headline: Taishin Shin Kong Financial: First Nine Months Profit NT$64.17 Billion, Up 184% Year on Year; EPS NT$2.47 Sets Record High
summary: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding reported cumulative after-tax profit of NT$64.17 billion for the first nine months, up 184% year on year, with EPS of NT$2.47 at a record high.
why: Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding is a Taiwan-listed financial holding company with banking, insurance and securities businesses.
